findings.title: Unrestricted user creation allows role escalation

findings.recommendation: Define a $fillable array that excludes privileged fields such as 'role', or explicitly set the role server‑side.

verification.notes: User::create($request->all()) uses a model with $guarded = [], allowing all attributes—including 'role'—to be mass‑assigned. No server‑side role assignment or guard is present.

findings.title: Team creation allows arbitrary owner assignment
findings.impact: Any authenticated user can set 'owner_id' to any user ID, creating a team under that user and gaining implicit ownership.
findings.recommendation: Remove 'owner_id' from $fillable and set it server‑side to the current user’s ID.

verification.notes: Team::create($request->all()) allows 'owner_id' to be set via the request. No server‑side assignment of the current user’s ID is performed.
